# A loop that folds into a local with +, *, &, |, ^, min or max is rewritten to
# fold whole vectors into an accumulator that starts at the operation's identity;
# the lanes are combined afterwards and the elements that do not fill a vector
# run the original body. The accumulator is read nowhere else in the loop, so the
# grouping does not matter for integers. The sizes cover empty, shorter than a
# vector, exactly one, and with a tail.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Sum(a []int32, init int32) int32 {
	sum := init
	for i := range a {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// A range value variable, and a fold written acc = acc op x.
func Dot(a, b []uint16) uint16 {
	var d uint16
	for i, v := range a {
		d = d + v*b[i]
	}
	return d
}

func Min(a []int32) int32 {
	m := int32(1<<31 - 1)
	for i := range a {
		m = min(m, a[i])
	}
	return m
}

func Max(a []int8) int8 {
	m := int8(-128)
	for i := range a {
		m = max(a[i], m)
	}
	return m
}

func And(a []uint8) uint8 {
	x := uint8(255)
	for i := range a {
		x &= a[i]
	}
	return x
}

func Xor(a, b []uint64) uint64 {
	var x uint64
	for i := range a {
		x = x ^ (a[i] + b[i])
	}
	return x
}

func Product(a []uint32) uint32 {
	p := uint32(1)
	for i := range a {
		p *= a[i]
	}
	return p
}

// The limit is an int variable, and the loop runs backwards.
func SumN(a []int64, n int) int64 {
	var sum int64
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

func SumReverse(a []int16) int16 {
	var sum int16
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// A fold and a store in one loop.
func SumAndScale(dst, a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * 3
		sum += dst[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// The range loop has no index to continue from in the loop over what is left.
func SumValues(a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	for _, v := range a {
		sum += v
	}
	return sum
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func Sum(a []int32, init int32) int32 {
	sum := init
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 64 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(0)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [16]int32
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				sum = sum + _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			sum += a[i]
		}
	}
	return sum
}

// A range value variable, and a fold written acc = acc op x.
func Dot(a, b []uint16) uint16 {
	var d uint16
	if len(a) > 0 {
		_ = b[len(a)-1]
		{
			_i := 0
			if len(a) >= 128 {
				_a1 := simd.BroadcastUint16s(0)
				_lanes := _a1.Len()
				for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint16s(a[_i:])
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint16s(b[_i:])
					_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1.Mul(_v2))
				}
				var _buf1 [32]uint16
				_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
				for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
					d = d + _x
				}
			}
			for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
				v := a[i]
				d = d + v*b[i]
			}
		}
	}
	return d
}

func Min(a []int32) int32 {
	m := int32(1<<31 - 1)
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 64 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(2147483647)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Min(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [16]int32
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				m = min(m, _x)
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			m = min(m, a[i])
		}
	}
	return m
}

func Max(a []int8) int8 {
	m := int8(-128)
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 256 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt8s(-128)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt8s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Max(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [64]int8
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				m = max(m, _x)
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			m = max(a[i], m)
		}
	}
	return m
}

func And(a []uint8) uint8 {
	x := uint8(255)
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 256 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(255)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadUint8s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.And(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [64]uint8
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				x = x & _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			x &= a[i]
		}
	}
	return x
}

func Xor(a, b []uint64) uint64 {
	var x uint64
	if len(a) > 0 {
		_ = b[len(a)-1]
		{
			_i := 0
			if len(a) >= 32 {
				_a1 := simd.BroadcastUint64s(0)
				_lanes := _a1.Len()
				for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint64s(a[_i:])
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint64s(b[_i:])
					_a1 = _a1.Xor(_v1.Add(_v2))
				}
				var _buf1 [8]uint64
				_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
				for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
					x = x ^ _x
				}
			}
			for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
				x = x ^ (a[i] + b[i])
			}
		}
	}
	return x
}

func Product(a []uint32) uint32 {
	p := uint32(1)
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 64 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastUint32s(1)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadUint32s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Mul(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [16]uint32
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				p = p * _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			p *= a[i]
		}
	}
	return p
}

// The limit is an int variable, and the loop runs backwards.
func SumN(a []int64, n int) int64 {
	var sum int64
	if n > 0 {
		_ = a[n-1]
		{
			_i := 0
			if n >= 32 {
				_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt64s(0)
				_lanes := _a1.Len()
				for ; _i+_lanes <= n; _i += _lanes {
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt64s(a[_i:])
					_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1)
				}
				var _buf1 [8]int64
				_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
				for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
					sum = sum + _x
				}
			}
			for i := _i; i < n; i++ {
				sum += a[i]
			}
		}
	}
	return sum
}

func SumReverse(a []int16) int16 {
	var sum int16
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 128 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt16s(0)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt16s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [32]int16
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				sum = sum + _x
			}
		}
		for i := _i; i < len(a); i++ {
			sum += a[i]
		}
	}
	return sum
}

// A fold and a store in one loop.
func SumAndScale(dst, a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	_vcInt32s9_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(3)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] * 3
			sum += dst[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_i := 0
				if len(dst) >= 64 {
					_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(0)
					_lanes := _a1.Len()
					for ; _i+_lanes <= len(dst); _i += _lanes {
						_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(a[_i:])
						_v1.Mul(_vcInt32s9_1).Store(dst[_i:])
						_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(dst[_i:])
						_a1 = _a1.Add(_v2)
					}
					var _buf1 [16]int32
					_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
					for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
						sum = sum + _x
					}
				}
				for i := _i; i < len(dst); i++ {
					dst[i] = a[i] * 3
					sum += dst[i]
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return sum
}

// The range loop has no index to continue from in the loop over what is left.
func SumValues(a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	{
		_i := 0
		if len(a) >= 64 {
			_a1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(0)
			_lanes := _a1.Len()
			for ; _i+_lanes <= len(a); _i += _lanes {
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(a[_i:])
				_a1 = _a1.Add(_v1)
			}
			var _buf1 [16]int32
			_a1.Store(_buf1[:])
			for _, _x := range _buf1[:_lanes] {
				sum = sum + _x
			}
		}
		for _k := _i; _k < len(a); _k++ {
			v := a[_k]
			sum += v
		}
	}
	return sum
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

// The sizes cover empty, shorter than a vector, exactly one, and a tail.
var sizes = []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 31, 33, 63, 64, 65, 100, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 257, 300, 1000}

func checksum(s []int32) (sum int64) {
	for i, v := range s {
		sum += int64(v) * int64(i+1)
	}
	return sum
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range sizes {
		a32 := make([]int32, n)
		a16 := make([]uint16, n)
		b16 := make([]uint16, n)
		a8 := make([]int8, n)
		u8 := make([]uint8, n)
		a64 := make([]uint64, n)
		b64 := make([]uint64, n)
		u32 := make([]uint32, n)
		s64 := make([]int64, n)
		s16 := make([]int16, n)
		for i := range n {
			a32[i] = int32(i*7919 - 500)
			a16[i], b16[i] = uint16(i*31+1), uint16(i*17+3)
			a8[i] = int8(i*13 - 60)
			u8[i] = uint8(0xff &^ (1 << (i % 7)))
			a64[i], b64[i] = uint64(i)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15, uint64(i*i)
			u32[i] = uint32(i%5 + 1)
			s64[i] = int64(i) << 40
			s16[i] = int16(i * 1001)
		}
		dst := make([]int32, n)
		fmt.Println(n, test.Sum(a32, 5), test.Dot(a16, b16), test.Min(a32), test.Max(a8),
			test.And(u8), test.Xor(a64, b64), test.Product(u32), test.SumN(s64, n),
			test.SumReverse(s16), test.SumAndScale(dst, a32), checksum(dst), test.SumValues(a32))
	}
}

//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func Sum(a []int32, init int32) int32 {
	sum := init
	for i := range a {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// A range value variable, and a fold written acc = acc op x.
func Dot(a, b []uint16) uint16 {
	var d uint16
	for i, v := range a {
		d = d + v*b[i]
	}
	return d
}

func Min(a []int32) int32 {
	m := int32(1<<31 - 1)
	for i := range a {
		m = min(m, a[i])
	}
	return m
}

func Max(a []int8) int8 {
	m := int8(-128)
	for i := range a {
		m = max(a[i], m)
	}
	return m
}

func And(a []uint8) uint8 {
	x := uint8(255)
	for i := range a {
		x &= a[i]
	}
	return x
}

func Xor(a, b []uint64) uint64 {
	var x uint64
	for i := range a {
		x = x ^ (a[i] + b[i])
	}
	return x
}

func Product(a []uint32) uint32 {
	p := uint32(1)
	for i := range a {
		p *= a[i]
	}
	return p
}

// The limit is an int variable, and the loop runs backwards.
func SumN(a []int64, n int) int64 {
	var sum int64
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

func SumReverse(a []int16) int16 {
	var sum int16
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		sum += a[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// A fold and a store in one loop.
func SumAndScale(dst, a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * 3
		sum += dst[i]
	}
	return sum
}

// The range loop has no index to continue from in the loop over what is left.
func SumValues(a []int32) int32 {
	var sum int32
	for _, v := range a {
		sum += v

	return sum
}
